function.name: get_pipeline
function.description: Inspect the saved pipeline graph and its project revision.

function.name: get_node_schema
function.description: Resolve a saved pipeline node's output columns and dtypes plus the columns arriving on each of its inputs, keyed by the name the node's own code uses. A node reporting unresolved_reason 'node_has_no_code' is an empty transform already wired into the graph and awaiting its code: write that code onto it with update_node rather than adding a parallel node beside it.

function.name: get_node_config
function.description: Inspect one saved node's complete configuration.

function.name: get_column_profiles
function.description: Summarise the values in one node frame before writing code against it: per column, the distinct levels of a small-cardinality categorical with their counts, or the min/max of a numeric or date column, alongside a null count and, where the dtype can be counted, a distinct count. Temporal and decimal bounds are reported in their written form ('2024-01-01', '12.50'). Call this instead of assuming how a column encodes its categories - a 'fault' or 'status' column may hold Y/N, true/false, or a description, and the schema alone cannot tell you which. Pass 'input' to profile one of the node's inputs by the name its code binds. Returns no rows: a value appears only as a distinct level, and a high-cardinality column is withheld.

input.description: Profile this input of the node instead of the node's own output, named exactly as get_node_schema reports it under 'inputs'. Omit to profile the node's own output.

function.name: list_datasets
function.description: List safe installed-format datasets in one project directory, optionally recursively.

function.name: get_dataset_schema
function.description: Inspect a dataset schema without implicitly reading rows.

function.name: get_project_knowledge
function.description: Retrieve bounded policy-filtered project facts and untrusted documentation.

function.name: get_example
function.description: Load one packaged, versioned teaching example.

function.name: get_authoring_guide
function.description: Retrieve the packaged canonical authoring guide with attribution.

function.name: plan_recipe
function.description: Select and plan one installed canonical recipe with its explicit structured arguments. Supply output_name and explicit output_columns together for a response output. Pass only the returned recipe_plan_hash to dry_run_recipe_plan; canonical operations remain server-side.

source.description: Existing saved graph node id that supplies the recipe input.

name.description: New graph node name exactly as requested; distinct from every output column name.

column.description: Existing categorical input column to band.

output_column.description: New output column that receives the band label; not the graph node name.

value.description: Non-null finite JSON scalar matched exactly.

assignment.description: Band label assigned when the value matches.

default.description: Fallback band label when no rule matches.

output_name.description: Optional new response output graph node connected after the recipe node.

output_columns.description: Columns selected into the optional response output.

items.description: Simple JSON-field column name to map to the same response field name.

name.description: New graph node name exactly as requested; distinct from every output column name.
New graph node name exactly as requested; distinct from every output column name.

join_name.description: New graph node name exactly as requested; distinct from every output column name.

join_key.description: Column present in both Parquet sources.

transform_name.description: New graph node name exactly as requested; distinct from every output column name.

items.description: Existing factor column, in row-value order.

output_column.description: New output column produced by this table.

factor_values.description: Non-null finite JSON scalar values aligned positionally with factors.

items.description: One factor value; null and non-finite numbers are invalid.

value.description: Finite numeric rating value for this factor combination.

default_value.description: Finite fallback rating value when no entry matches.

base_value.description: Finite numeric base included in the combination.

left_on.description: Ordered join columns on the main/base input.

right_on.description: Ordered join columns on the joining/reference input.

function.name: dry_run_recipe_plan
function.description: Dry-run exactly one pending canonical recipe by recipe_plan_hash.

function.name: dry_run_graph_edits
function.description: Validate an exact graph-edit plan and report revision, semantic diff, postconditions, authority and verification tier without writing.

node_type.description: Node type id, exactly as the prompt's node index lists it.

config.description: Config keys, as the node type's descriptor config schema lists them. add_node starts the node from the palette's config for its type and writes these keys over it. update_node merges shallowly: each key written replaces that key's whole value, so send a nested object or list complete; keys not written keep their saved values; a JSON null removes the key.

ref.description: Declares a batch-local handle for this new node. Write the bare name here without a leading '$' (for example "agg"); later operations in the same batch address it as "$agg".

node.description: Node id, or a batch-local $ref declared by an earlier add_node.

source.description: Node id, or a batch-local $ref declared by an earlier add_node.

target.description: Node id, or a batch-local $ref declared by an earlier add_node.

source_handle.description: Output port on the source node, exactly as get_pipeline reports it under an edge's 'source_handle'. Required only when the source emits several frames, such as an apiInput table; omit it for an ordinary single-output node.

target_handle.description: Input port on the target node, exactly as get_pipeline reports it under an edge's 'target_handle'. Only nodes with named input roles use it: an edgeJoin requires 'base' or 'join'. Omit it for an ordinary node such as polars, which binds inputs by source name and has no input ports.

function.name: apply_graph_plan
function.description: Apply one exact validated plan hash under revision authority.

function.name: get_capability_manifest
function.description: Read manifest identity and its compact capability index.

function.name: get_capability_descriptors
